description: Per-frame overrides for the DISP-CAL algorithm (Venti plan T27). plate: ITRF2020-PMM plate for the plate_motion layer (PRD D3: NA default, PA Hawaii, CA Puerto Rico; California stays NA). tropo.mode: from the trade studies (tropo_check). uncertainty.k_grid: per frame from TS-G1 (2026-10-09, disp2vlm_validation studies/TS-G1/REPORT.md: std fit of grid-vs-MIDAS LOS velocity residuals on a held-out 30% station split, UNR constant grid v0.3 IGS20); default 3.9 (the earlier F08882 placeholder) for frames without a fit. benchmark_category: PRD section 2.7 (frames 5-8 chosen 2026-10-09, plan T40.1: OPERA frame DB, DISP-S1 product and UNR station counts); 38238 is the descending partner of 08882 for VLM (T56). Values here are consumed once the T34/T35/T37 code paths land; with schema-v2 defaults they change nothing. 0.4-draft (2026-10-13): surface.regions = separate for F08882, F16940, F35991 (T62 edge pass: island cycle/offset errors; venti-dev #32). 0.5-draft (2026-10-14): surface.fit_mask = F08882_stable_coh07.tif for F08882 (stack-mean temporal coherence >= 0.7 over the 204-product 2016-2023 stack, venti-fit-mask; T62 edge pass: Matagorda). 0.6-draft (2026-10-14): tropo.mode = stratified for F35991 (TS-T1, disp2vlm_validation studies/TS-T1: at 0.70 km relief the humid tropical frame improves with the correction, velocity RMSE -0.38 and |bias| -0.41 mm/yr vs off; New York and Montana in the same band do not, so auto stays off there). 0.7-draft (2026-10-20): F18904, the descending partner of F16940 for LA VLM (T57), gets the LA settings: surface.regions = separate and tropo.mode = stratified. Unlisted, its Catalina island offset was wrong (CAT2 LOS -54.2 vs GNSS -29.7 mm/yr) and the LA VLM put CAT2 at -13.1 mm/yr; with both settings: F18904 DISP gate PASS, DD sill -91.4% vs raw (-89.0% unlisted), LA VLM gated NMAD 1.32 mm/yr (1.46 unlisted), CAT2 -2.1 (GNSS -1.0); k_grid keeps the default (no TS-G1 fit for F18904). Runs: cal_disp_e2e/t57/la_release, la_regions, la_full. 0.8-draft (2026-10-21): tropo.mode = stratified for F23211 Hawaii (1.62 km relief, where auto also chooses it). Stratified vs off on cal-disp v0.5.3: DD sill -27.6% [-40.5, -19.4], velocity RMSE 2.40 -> 2.30 mm/yr; the +0.50 mm/yr |median bias| rise on 18 stations is not significant [-0.39, +0.92] (disp2vlm_validation decision 0004, accepted 2026-10-21). Run: cal_disp_e2e/t57/hawaii_v053.
